# Sine Voltage

Generic repository-authored M2C syntax fixture, independent of private/coursework schematics.

Device body and ordinal mappings were authored from the M2 contract; no exporter was used to create expected text. Header hashes use canonical JSON and the independent electrical projection retained in expected-export.json. The mapping and artifact hashes cover their explicit native projection/exact LF bytes.

Explicit test review creates CIRCUIT_EXPORT approval; these assets contain no approval authority. Source DC equals waveform initial value where present. No analysis directive, model or simulator execution is included. These are exact-byte syntax expectations, not LTspice compatibility or numerical/physical validation.
